label: Google Drive
description: Official Google Drive MCP server (hosted, Workspace Developer Preview). Lets the agent search files, read file metadata and content, and download files. Requires your own Google OAuth client.

setup.reason: bring your own Google OAuth client: add google-drive to mcpServers with clientId, clientSecret, callbackPort and scopes, then run /mcp login google-drive (guide: https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent/blob/main/docs/google-workspace-mcp.md)
